achievements.name: Better Luck Nest Time
achievements.description: Score at least 80 points in a game when one of your opponents has a raven in the same habitat as a Franklin's Gull or Killdeer.

achievements.name: ILL EAGLE
achievements.description: Succeed in 10 or more predator hunts in one game.

achievements.name: What the Flock
achievements.description: Have more than 25 cards tucked under one bird in a single game.

achievements.name: Beak Performance
achievements.description: Score 120 points or more in a single game.

achievements.name: A Real Know-it-owl
achievements.description: Unlock all birds in the bird atlas. (By playing each of them at least once)

achievements.name: Fully Fledged
achievements.description: Play 15 birds in a single game.

achievements.name: Attempted Murder
achievements.description: Play 3 ravens and/or crows in the same habitat.

achievements.name: This Present Caw-st a Fortune
achievements.description: Have at least 60 points worth of birds at the end of one game.

achievements.name: Toucan of My Appreciation
achievements.description: Give other players food tokens on at least 5 turns in one game.

achievements.name: Investing in the Stork Market
achievements.description: Score points with the Fishery Manager and Wetland Scientist cards in the same game.

achievements.name: A Bird’s Best Subject? Owl-jay-bra
achievements.description: Have more than 30 points worth of bonus points in one game.

achievements.name: Here's My Number, so Caw Me Maybe
achievements.description: Play one bird of each point value (0-9) in a game.

achievements.name: Clutch Performance
achievements.description: Win a game with at least 35 eggs in your preserve.

achievements.name: Free-for-owl
achievements.description: Win a 5-player match.

achievements.name: Owl of a Sudden
achievements.description: Play three or more birds in a single turn.

achievements.name: Wild Goose Chase
achievements.description: Score at least 16 points from the Omnivore bonus card.

achievements.name: Egg-streme Measures
achievements.description: Have all eggs slots filled at the end of the game.

achievements.name: Early Bird Gets the Worm
achievements.description: Be the first player to play a bird that eats worms.

achievements.name: Money for Nothin' and Chicks for Free
achievements.description: Lay at least 10 eggs using pink powers in a single game.

achievements.name: Pheasant Diversion
achievements.description: Win against the Automa on Hard difficulty.

achievements.name: Wake Me up Before You Dodo
achievements.description: Play 5 bonus card birds in the same game. (Birds whose powers grant bonus cards are generally threatened/vulnerable/endangered species, or at least have a subspecies that is.)

achievements.name: Fly Like an Eagle
achievements.description: Play 5 predators in a game.

achievements.name: By the Pricking of My Thumbs, Something Winged This Way Comes
achievements.description: Finish your first game of Wingspan.

achievements.name: Birds of a Feather
achievements.description: Play 3 birds worth 5 or more VPs in the same habitat.

achievements.name: Fair-feather Friends
achievements.description: Move a bird between habitats five times in a game.

achievements.name: Build Two Birds with One Stone
achievements.description: Play two birds in one turn.

achievements.name: A Bird in the Hand
achievements.description: Have one bird in your hand and two in your forest at the end of your turn.

achievements.name: Bird Brained
achievements.description: Win a game against the AI.

achievements.name: Once Bittern, Twice Shy
achievements.description: Win a game with a score of at least 90 points with no more than 1 bird in your Wetland.

achievements.name: Quacking under Pressure
achievements.description: Finish a game having a lower point total than during the game.

achievements.name: The Eagle Has Landed
achievements.description: Finish the Tutorial

achievements.name: Passenger 57
achievements.description: Play 16 birds in a single game.

achievements.name: Eggs-istential crisis
achievements.description: End the game with 0 eggs.

achievements.name: A Real Know-it-owl: Europe
achievements.description: Play at least once all the new birds of the Wingspan: European Expansion

achievements.name: Birdnado
achievements.description: Score over 180 points in a single game.

achievements.name: Doomsday Prepper
achievements.description: Cache 15 food on birds using only the predator powers.

achievements.name: European Union
achievements.description: Have five European birds in one habitat.

achievements.name: Full Tuck!
achievements.description: Get at least a 70 of tucked cards in your final score.

achievements.name: Rat Bird
achievements.description: Use three cards to pay for bird rather than rats and tuck all three.

achievements.name: Robin Crow
achievements.description: Steal 10 food from your opponents' supplies in a single game.

achievements.name: There's always a bigger bird!
achievements.description: Play a bird on top of another bird whose wingspan is larger than the previous one.

achievements.name: Wait, one more thing!
achievements.description: Trigger three or more end of round powers in one round.

achievements.name: Nectar of Life
achievements.description: Win 1st place in all 3 habitats when scoring points for nectar spent.

achievements.name: Nectar Jackpot
achievements.description: End the game with EXACTLY seven nectar spent in each habitat (777).

achievements.name: All Birds, Aligned!
achievements.description: Play 5 birds in one habitat with beaks pointing in the same direction.

achievements.name: Fly me to the Moor
achievements.description: Send the Tui or Superb Lyrebird to the grassland habitat by copying a migratory bird power.

achievements.name: Unflappable
achievements.description: Play 3 flightless birds in one game.

achievements.name: Global Analyst
achievements.description: Score all 3 Analyst bonus cards (Forest, Grassland, and Wetland) in one game.

achievements.name: The Tuckinator
achievements.description: Tuck at least 50 cards under one bird.

achievements.name: Mellow Yellow
achievements.description: Win a game with 5 or more GAME END powers.

achievements.name: By Our Powers Combined
achievements.description: Play 5 birds with different power types/colors in one habitat.

achievements.name: Sweet Tooth
achievements.description: Play five nectar-eating birds in a single habitat.

achievements.name: A Real Know-it-owl: Oceania
achievements.description: Play at least once all the new birds of the Wingspan: Oceania Expansion.

achievements.name: Tailored Fit
achievements.description: Lay 15 eggs at once with the Common Tailorbird.

achievements.name: Devoted to Duet
achievements.description: Place more than 15 Tokens on the Duet Map in one game.

achievements.name: Jackpot Cache
achievements.description: Use a push-your-luck bird to cache 15+ food on it.

achievements.name: Like Your Birds, But Better
achievements.description: Score an opponent’s bonus card to earn more points from it than them.

achievements.name: Owl Hands On Deck
achievements.description: Activate 5 predator powers at the end of a single round using the Oriental Bay-Owl.

achievements.name: We're SO Back
achievements.description: Win a game while scoring 21 points or more on the "Endangered Species Protector" bonus card.

achievements.name: Swan Song, Solo
achievements.description: In Duet Mode, place no tokens on bonus spaces and win the game.

achievements.name: To Egg-Finity and Beyond!
achievements.description: End the game with at least 3 of your birds having gone over their egg nest limit.

achievements.name: Flying International
achievements.description: Send 3 birds to an opponent's preserve.

achievements.name: Double Agent
achievements.description: Copy another player's bird power to move a bird to another player's preserve.

achievements.name: A Real Know-it-owl: Asia
achievements.description: Play at least once all the new birds of the Wingspan: Asia Expansion.
